request.style: English, deep male solo voice with celtic choir, bodhran, uilleann pipes, harp, tin whistle, fiddle, somber and reflective mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Eliphaz the Temanite came from afar
With Bildad and Zophar to meet you there
They looked from a distance, could not recognize you
Wept aloud, tore robes, tossed dust to the sky

[Verse]
They sat with you on the ground for seven days
And seven nights, no word spoken in praise
Your suffering was great, they saw your pain
Silent witnesses to your deep distress

[Chorus]
Seven days silent, no word was said
Watching the sorrow that you have spread
Your friends are here, though their words may fail
To comfort the soul in the dark and cold

[Verse]
Then Eliphaz spoke, who can hold back
When trouble strikes and the body is weak
You strengthened the weak, held up the stumbling
But now you are dismayed, your spirit crumbling

[Verse]
He spoke of a vision, a spirit passed by
A whisper in the dark, a voice from the sky
Who ever perished being innocent
Where were the upright ever destroyed

[Chorus]
Seven days silent, no word was said
Watching the sorrow that you have spread
Your friends are here, though their words may fail
To comfort the soul in the dark and cold

[Verse]
He accused you of sin, of taking pledges
Of refusing water, of hiding treasures
But God spoke from the storm, rebuked them all
For not speaking rightly of His own will

[Outro]
Offer seven bulls, seven rams as well
Job prays for you, God forgives your soul
